text: This man sold the Eiffel Tower... for scrap.
At least, that's what the agent who caught him wrote.
His forged letter said the tower was rusting and would be scrapped. Secretly.
Scrap dealers met him at a luxury hotel. One bit.
He even paid a bribe. One account says seventy thousand dollars.
The buyer stayed quiet. So Lustig came back... and tried again.
This time, someone told the police. He fled to America.
There, he made fake hundred-dollar bills.
He escaped jail on a bedsheet rope... and still ended up on Alcatraz.
His death certificate listed his job as "apprentice salesman."
